_PROVENANCE.purpose: Improve REAL log10 chl-a retrieval beyond the red-edge GBM baseline (hydrovit_rededge.json R2=0.3383) with richer pigment features + small ensemble.
_PROVENANCE.data: data/processed/biology/noaa_habs/mc_tiles (REAL Sentinel-2 L2A 6-band tiles) x mc_fusion_dataset.parquet (REAL WQP/NOAA-HABS in-situ CHLA).
_PROVENANCE.baseline_representation: rededge (91 feats): 6 raw bands + NDVI/NDWI/GR + NDCI/CIre/MCIre/FAI
_PROVENANCE.ensemble: HistGBM + ExtraTrees, OOF-averaged inside each fold (no test leakage).
_PROVENANCE.FINDING: The extra pigment features did NOT help (baseline rededge set already saturates the linear pigment signal); the honest gain comes from the HGB+ExtraTrees ENSEMBLE (model-class change) on the SAME 91 rededge features.
_PROVENANCE.split: STATION (site) GroupKFold — no site shared train/test.
_PROVENANCE.ci: site-clustered bootstrap (resamples sites, not rows), 2000 reps; paired delta on same sites.

baselineFeat_ENSEMBLE.note: HGB+ExtraTrees ensemble on the SAME 91 rededge features (no new pigment feats). Isolates the model-class gain from the feature-engineering gain.
